plan.title: coverage-debt: restore Vitest branches >=85% (84.99% at v0.94.0 preflight)

narratives.Description: Release Step 5 / task check failed the Vitest branch coverage hairline at 84.99% on the v0.94.0 cut while other metrics already met 85%. This story restores all four Vitest metrics to >=85% and closes the coverage-debt ledger issue so soft-pass is no longer needed.
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

Release Step 5 / `task check` Vitest **branch** coverage hairline on the v0.94.0 cut.

## Measured (local `task check` 2026-08-03)

- Statements: 88.19%
- Branches: **84.99%** (sole metric below 85%)
- Functions: 95.81%
- Lines: 88.19%

## Hatch

`coverage-debt` / `--allow-coverage-debt` — release-scoped open-issue ledger hatch (#2866 / #2573). Branch-only trigger; other metrics already ≥ 85%.

## Acceptance

Restore **all four** Vitest metrics (lines, functions, branches, statements) to ≥ 85% and close this issue. Do not soft-pass again while this issue remains open.
narratives.UserStory: As a release operator, I want Vitest branch coverage at or above 85%, so that task check and release Step 5 pass without the coverage-debt hatch.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Reproduce branch coverage shortfall with task check / vitest coverage and identify files/branches below the gate. 2. Add or tighten unit tests for the uncovered branches (prefer high-ROI modules near the hairline). 3. Confirm statements, branches, functions, and lines all report >=85%. 4. CHANGELOG [Unreleased] note for #3103. 5. Do not re-open the coverage-debt hatch while this issue remains open.
